{{Navbar-GOGPT-tracker}}
'''P.Nallur Combined Cycle power plant''' is an operating power station of at least 331-megawatts (MW) in Pillaiperumalnallur, Tamil Nadu, India with multiple units, some of which are not currently operating.
It is also known as Pillaiperumalnallur.

CHP is an abbreviation for Combined Heat and Power. It is a technology that produces electricity and thermal energy at high efficiencies. Coal units track this information in the Captive Use section when known.
